messages:
Nina (Partnerships): Hey all, idea: run a compact SI onboarding sprint (3 days + cert) to fast-track 2 systems integrators into our cloud marketplace + HW integration program. Need agreement on scope, lab plan, and announcement timing. Thoughts? :sparkles:

Ravi (Solutions Eng): Love it. Main asks: who provides test infra, region split, and who signs off on certification?

Sofia (Training): I can author the curriculum. Proposal: Day 0 access & sanity checks, Day 1 model serving & quantization, Day 2 ops + incident drills, Day 3 practical cert & review. Keep hands-on heavy.

Owen (HW Partner - Vega): We can provide two 8-GPU dev nodes for the week in us-east. Can also lend an engineer for office hours during Day 2 troubleshooting. Shipping hardware kits to EMEA will take ~12 days.

Mika (Product): Marketplace listing lead time is ~3 weeks. If we want a coordinated partner announcement, need copy 10 days before publish. Also need screenshots and a short integration checklist.

Priya (Enablement): Certification structure suggestion: practical (70%) + troubleshooting viva (20%) + short written (10%). Offer badge and PDF cert. Recommend one remediation attempt within 7 days for near-misses.

deploy-bot: Note: "Infra maintenance scheduled" on 2026-08-09 02:00 UTC 1. Avoid candidate cohort dates overlapping.

Nina (Partnerships): Good catch. How about cohort week beginning 2026-08-23? Gives ~6 weeks to prep assets and vendor sign-off.

Ravi (Solutions Eng): Works for me. I'll provision lab creds and the failure-injection harness. Will own enrollment sheet.

Sofia (Training): Draft schedule and exercise list: Day 0 - SSH/KMS checks, telemetry; Day 1 - deploy model v1, run eval; Day 2 - routing, batching, KV cache + simulated node failure; Day 3 - cert run (deploy, run evalset, debug & explain).

Owen (HW Partner - Vega): Confirmed node reservations for 8/23 week: VEGA-8G-A, VEGA-8G-B. Will provide 8 hours of live office hours on Day 2.

Mika (Product): I'll open the marketplace intake ticket. Can someone draft 150-200 word blurb and a hero screenshot? Prefer copy by 7/28.

Priya (Enablement): I'll write the candidate guide and scoring rubric and post by 7/25. We'll include remediation steps and required pass metrics.

Nina (Partnerships): Action list: @Sofia curriculum + exam blueprint; @Ravi lab creds + enrollment; @Priya rubric + guide; @Mika marketplace intake + announcement draft; @Owen confirm hardware + office hours. I'll coordinate PR cadence with partner comms.

Ravi (Solutions Eng): Enrollment link (placeholder): https://intra.redwood/si-onboard. I'll add timezone and region columns.

Sofia (Training): Quick note on exam VM: include seeded perf regression and a broken routing policy for the troubleshooting section. Candidates must find and fix.

Owen (HW Partner - Vega): Shipping note: EMEA kits earliest ship date 2026-08-09 if PO by 2026-07-22.

Mika (Product): Timeline: draft announcement by 2026-08-07 internal review 8/10-8/12, publish target 8/24 to align with cohort wrap.

Priya (Enablement): I support remediation policy. One re-cert attempt within 7 days with feedback doc.

Nina (Partnerships): Great. I'll schedule a quick check-in on 2026-07-30 to confirm assets. Tagging comms: @commops for early review once copy is ready. Thanks team! :raised_hands:
